title: LADA Y vs Flounders, Oct 19
notes: Home game at Snoqualmie A: we wore white and had the left bench; Flounders wore black with light-blue trim. The 3438x1374 LiveBarn recording (uploaded Oct 31; YouTube's bot check blocked the download until it was fetched with browser cookies) was scaled up to the rink's usual frame. It sits at the same slightly lower framing as the other late uploads here (BW and BT Oct 25), so the geometry and the ice maps fit unchanged. The game sheet (SportNinja, read through its public API) gave the score, the goals, the penalties, the shots and who played; the arena scoreboard and the video confirmed the score.

Periods by the scoreboard clock (we were HOME): 0:19-18:38, 20:27-38:28 and 40:24-63:34 of the video. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd. The 1st ends at 18:38, not where the clock reader put it (18:34): the clock held at 1.2 s for a faceoff and then ran out. The video runs to the final horn. Final 1-2, shots 23-27 (8-5, 7-9, 8-13), from the sheet.
Goals at 8:13 (Flounders #15 Bell, out of a scramble at our post), 21:07 (ours) and 24:01 (#9 Nash, from #7 and #5) of the video, each found by eye and matched to the board's clock.

Our goal: the game sheet credits Yafunyaev #29 (assists Ber #14 and Petrov #18), but in the video Lisitsyn #70 ('70 LISITSYN' readable as he carries it) takes it along the far boards and jams it in at their post with Ber at the crease, while Yafunyaev sits on the front of our bench (purple pants) from 20:48 to 21:21. The clip and the on-ice list follow the video; the sheet's credit is left as it is.

No penalties for us; Flounders took two in the 3rd (Bell, body check; Nowak, hooking). Hilfer left our net at 62:25, in the stoppage for Nowak's hooking with 0:57 left, and we played six skaters on four to the end.

Twelve skaters. Beregovoy played in #67, his white-jersey number; the sheet didn't mark him playing. Lisitsyn #32 was marked playing but didn't appear: the 21 reads of '32' were #82's sleeve, against 76-122 reads in our last two white games. Absent: #4 Sokolov, #11 Belousenko, #32 Lisitsyn, #37 Akulov and #49 Unuchek.

925 review rows; two labeled by hand in the 2nd (the scorer's track after the goal is #70, not #89, and a skater stepping into the bench is not #89). Two passes of the by-eye lineup check added 36 on/off spans, most of them line changes at the bench door during stoppages and a few lost tracks (#78 in the crease pile at the first goal against, #67 at our net at the second).

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 10:05: Bell #15 (unassisted) out of a scramble at our left post, 0-1

2nd period, clock 17:20: Lisitsyn #70 carries it along the far boards and jams it in at their post with Ber at the crease, 1-1 (the game sheet credits Yafunyaev #29, from Ber and Petrov; he was on the bench)
2nd period, clock 14:26: Nash #9 (from #7, #5) comes around our net and tucks it past the goalie, 1-2
